title: thymophylla neomexicana
intro: Thymophylla neomexicana, commonly known as New Mexico dwarf daisy or New Mexico bush daisy, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Thymophylla neomexicana include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. Bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
